evals.prompt: review my branch before I merge it
evals.expected_output: Diffs against the merge base, runs correctness, security and tests-and-docs lenses, and returns verified findings by severity with a must-fix list. Edits nothing.

evals.prompt: review this branch. main moved on after I branched
evals.expected_output: Reviews only the branch's own changes, and reports none of the commits added to main after the branch point.

evals.prompt: review my changes. acceptance criteria: 1. rejects empty input 2. logs the failure
evals.expected_output: Checks each criterion and flags any that is neither covered by a finding nor visibly satisfied by the diff.
